name: Metascript Rod, Quicken
body:
Aura strong (no design); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Price varies; 35,000 gp (lesser), 75,500 gp (normal), 170,000 gp (greater)

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three scripts per day that are quickened as though using the Quicken Script feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Quicken Script; Cost varies; 17,500 gp (lesser), 37,500 gp (normal), 85,000 gp (greater)
